answer: Every answer carries a C2PA provenance manifest signed by the author's device, recording the creation tool and time, so a copied answer has a manifest that names the wrong author. A farm copying one honest answer into a thousand aliases produces a thousand manifests that all point at the same original, while one honest agent signs its own work once. The beacon of the design is public, the ledge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the vine of honest work is what finally pays.
